name: Broken Boom Gang
reason: Unpaid guards who took a boom lodge; masterless, so their name is a local label.

name: Thorn Field Owners
reason: Saltrice field title on the frontier is the Accord's argument (40-factions §40; world/sources/lore/thorn.md).

name: Crystalgate Cutting Houses
reason: Stormhold taxes the crystal that passes its gates; the cutters work under the city's administration (world/sources/lore/stormhold.md).

name: Keepers of the Shell
reason: Hatching pools under a Hist are Hist stewardship (world/sources/lore/topics/hist-and-sap.md).

name: Root Stewards
reason: Root stewards are Hist stewardship (world/sources/lore/topics/hist-and-sap.md).

name: Hutan Tzel Tribe
reason: A tribe answers to its own Hist (world/sources/lore/tribes.md).

name: Stormhold Vicecanons
reason: Stormhold's officers hold the city for the administration on the Morrowind frontier screen (world/sources/lore/stormhold.md; an-xileel.md).

name: Charge Works Houses
reason: Village works processing wamasu; a trade under its village.

name: Jumped Claim Gang
reason: Claim-jumpers with no master; a local label.

name: Salt Carriers
reason: Carriers on an uncounted route past a border post are smugglers, the thieves' guild's trade.

name: Shut Village Elders
reason: Village elders; a local label.

name: Helstrom Assembly
reason: Helstrom was founded under the grove's tree-minders; its assembly is Hist stewardship (world/sources/lore/helstrom.md).

name: Swampmoth Toll Company
reason: A toll company in a Legion fort on the Gideon frontier: the left-behind garrison.

name: Gideon Civic Council
reason: Gideon's civic offices are the administration's, contested but held (world/sources/lore/gideon.md; an-xileel.md).

name: Gideon Magistracy
reason: Gideon's courthouse is the records city's working court under the administration (world/sources/lore/gideon.md; topics/labour-and-bondage.md).

name: Ca Uxith Tribe
reason: A tribe answers to its own Hist; tribes are not province factions unless briefed as powers (world/sources/lore/tribes.md).

name: Blackrose City Government
reason: The administration holds the island core, so in 4E 201 it holds the prison city (world/sources/lore/blackrose.md; an-xileel.md).

name: Blackrose Island Council
reason: Same body as the Blackrose city government under another name.

name: Blackrose Tenders
reason: Tenders of a Hist are Hist stewardship, the Conclave's remit (world/sources/lore/topics/hist-and-sap.md).

name: Blackrose Tree Speakers
reason: Tree-speakers of the drowned Hist: Hist stewardship, the Conclave (world/sources/lore/topics/hist-and-sap.md).

name: Rose Born Families
reason: Prison-born families of the Rose are the Blackrose Chainbreakers' constituency (40-factions §39; world/sources/lore/topics/prisons.md).

name: Refused Vault Keeper
reason: Keeping the refused dead is funerary custom, the Nisswo's (world/sources/lore/topics/sithis-nisswo-shadowscales.md).

name: Brammans Pilots
reason: River pilots on Red Bramman's route are boat crews on a route, the Compact's remit (world/sources/lore/regions/waters.md).

name: Drag Windlass Crew
reason: Portage crews hauling boats are part of the boat-route labour the Compact organises.

name: Windlass Crew
reason: Same portage crew as the drag-windlass crew.

name: Jumped Claim Gang
reason: Claim-jumpers with no master; a local label.

name: Spine Households
reason: Households of one village; a local label.

name: Lake Divers
reason: A divers' yard; a trade under its place.

name: Ledgered Blackguards
reason: A Blackguards cell held under the Owing ledger; same company, local name (world/sources/lore/topics/labour-and-bondage.md).

name: Longmont Freight Households
reason: Freight households moving goods by pole-boat: the Compact's labour.

name: Longmont Polers
reason: Polers are boat crews.

name: Three Gate Compact
reason: A city toll whose debtor pit the city denies: the administration's tolls.

name: Third Generation
reason: Third-generation prison-born: the Chainbreakers' constituency (40-factions §39).

name: Rockspring Levee Households
reason: Levee households of one village; a local label.

name: Umbriel Dead
reason: Umbriel's leavings are objects and have no standing as a group (world/sources/lore/topics/umbriel.md).

name: Blackguards Raw
reason: Spelling variant of the Blackguards: an unledgered cell of the same company.

name: Threewater Scale Holders
reason: Market scale-holders of one town; a local label.

name: Ashroot Village
reason: A village answers to its own Hist and elders, not to a province faction (world/sources/lore/tribes.md); the name is its local group.

name: Sees No Root
reason: A bereaved village; a local label.

name: Chasepoint Wreck Households
reason: Households of one place; a local label.

name: Paid Arch Keepers
reason: One family tolling an arch since the Legion left; a local label.

name: Four Village Crown Compact
reason: A compact of four villages around one place; a local label.

name: Hereguard Estate
reason: One estate's household; a local label.

name: High Junction Deck Crew
reason: A deck crew at a boat junction: the Compact's crews.

name: The Fringe
reason: The place record says a Blackguards cell took the quarter.

name: Chuxeth Clan
reason: A southern Murkmire clan in its xanmeer. The Bright-Throat are the Murkmire tribe that deals with outsiders (world/sources/lore/regions/murkmire.md; tribes.md).

name: Keel Sakka Landing
reason: A village landing; a local label.

name: Lighter Crews
reason: Lighter crews are boat labour, the Compact's remit.

name: Lilmoth Hist speakers
reason: A Hist is not a faction; those who speak for Lilmoth's Hist are the Conclave (world/sources/lore/topics/hist-and-sap.md).

name: Lilmoth Merchant Council
reason: Lilmoth is ruled by a merchant council that sits where the Organism keeps its seat and customs regime (world/sources/lore/lilmoth.md Government; an-xileel.md).

name: Long Bar Wreckers
reason: Wreckers on the pirate coast fence through the pirate confederation (world/sources/lore/regions/waters.md).

name: Blackguard
reason: Spelling variant of the Blackguards brigand company.

name: Moonmarch Caravan House
reason: A Khajiit moon-sugar landing outside Lilmoth's tariff; a large share of the Southern Sea pirates are Khajiit (world/sources/lore/regions/waters.md).

name: Mudfoot Cockle Households
reason: Cockle-gathering households; a local label.

name: Xul Vaat Stake Carvers
reason: Stake carvers of one necropolis village; a local label.

name: Long Walk Households
reason: Households of one boardwalk; a local label.

name: Estuary Ferry Holders
reason: Ferry holders are boat crews on a route.

name: Soulrest Breaking Yard
reason: A breaking yard's workers; a trade under its place.

name: Placation Court Holders
reason: The port keeps the court as the price of tribal tolerance; a local label.

name: White Fields Salters
reason: Salt-pan workers of one place; a local label.

name: Wraxu Egg Takers
reason: Egg-takers of one stack; a local label.

name: Xinchei Keeper
reason: A hereditary monument keeper; a local label.

name: Bone Carriers
reason: Walking the dead inland to rest is funerary rite, which the Nisswo keep (world/sources/lore/topics/sithis-nisswo-shadowscales.md).

name: Deepmire Caretakers
reason: Deepmire is where Sithis is strong; its keepers are Sithis's priests (world/sources/lore/topics/sithis-nisswo-shadowscales.md).

name: Sap Crew
reason: A crew holding a Hist hostage for sap is armed crime, the Blackguards' kind (world/sources/lore/topics/hist-and-sap.md).

name: Bone and Hide Works
reason: A working yard beside the Nine Ribs; a trade, not an allegiance.

name: Corimont Free Port Halls
reason: Alten Corimont is the pirate and smuggler port; its halls answer to the pirate confederation (world/sources/lore/alten-corimont.md; topics/guilds-and-orders.md).

name: Archon Harbour Authority
reason: The harbour authority at a recognised port is the customs regime the successor administration inherited (world/sources/lore/an-xileel.md, Inherited; world/sources/lore/archon.md).

name: Padomaic Wreckers
reason: Wreckers on the Archon pirate ground answer to the pirate confederation (world/sources/lore/regions/waters.md).
